concepts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one polished pixel-art concept sheet for an ORIGINAL tiny terminal pet species named SPRIG, a buttercream seedling bird: round pear-shaped fluffy chick with a mint-green sprout growing from its crown, small folded wings and peach stub feet. Show exactly FOUR growth stages side by side, baby, child, teen, adult, on a warm ivory background with generous space. Baby is a tiny round chick with one little sprout nub; child grows two short sprout leaves and tiny side wings; teen becomes pear-shaped with a three-feather wing; adult is a cuddly plump little garden bird with a two-leaf crown and a short upturned tail. Consistent recognizable species throughout. Extremely cute, very compact, large plain cream face patch; NO EYES OR MOUTH OR BEAK anywhere, these are added by the game engine later. No facial dots. Dark warm brown 1-pixel outline, cream highlight at upper left, buttery yellow body, warm gold shadow, sage mint leaves, peach feet. Restrained 5 fill colors. Actual chunky low-resolution pixel art enlarged nearest-neighbor, not vector, no blur or gradients. Target sprite heights about 9,11,13,15 pixels, widths 11 to 19 pixels. All sprites grounded, front view or slight three-quarter with face centered. No eggs, props, logos, text, watermarks. Do not imitate any existing franchise character.
